title: Buy-and-sell trader shot dead and his motorcycle driver wounded on the highway in Kadingilan, Nabalawag
summary: A gunman aboard a minivan opened fire on Darios Ondong Makakena, a buy-and-sell trader from Barangay Tumbras, Kadayangan, and the man driving the motorcycle he rode, along the highway in Sitio Ipil-Ipil, Barangay Kadingilan, Nabalawag, at about 12:10 p.m. on Tuesday, 24 November 2026. Makakena died at the scene and the driver was wounded. The pair were heading for Midsayap; the gunman fled in the same vehicle, and police had not named a suspect or a motive.
